GUNS & DRAGONS TRAINER v3.5.2 - INSTALL INSTRUCTIONS
=====================================================

A trainer for the Guns and Dragons Playtest (Steam), built as a UE4SS mod with an on-screen
settings window. Made for and tested on the Playtest build 1.0.1.518227 (Unreal Engine 5.7).


REQUIREMENTS
------------
- Windows 10 or 11.
- Guns and Dragons Playtest installed through Steam.
- .NET Framework 4.x (already part of Windows 10/11). The settings window needs it.
- Run the game in Borderless or Windowed mode so the trainer window can appear on top of it.


WHAT'S IN THIS ZIP
------------------
  INSTALL_INSTRUCTIONS.txt        this file
  Win64\                          everything that goes into the game's Win64 folder:
    dwmapi.dll                    loader for UE4SS (the mod framework)
    ue4ss\                        UE4SS v4.0.0 (MIT license, see ue4ss\LICENSE), already set up for this game:
      MemberVariableLayout.ini      REQUIRED fix for this game's engine version (without it the game
                                    crashes on launch)
      UE4SS-settings.ini            hot reload switched on (see "Reloading" below)
      Mods\mods.txt                 the trainer is already enabled in here
      Mods\GunsDragonsTrainer\      the trainer itself (scripts, icons, TrainerGUI.exe)


INSTALL
-------
1. Close the game.

2. Find the game folder: in Steam, right-click "Guns and Dragons Playtest" >
   Manage > Browse local files. A folder like this opens:
       ...\steamapps\common\GunsDragonsPlaytest

3. Open these folders inside it:
       EX\Binaries\Win64
   You should see EXGameSteam-Win64-Shipping.exe in there. This is the target folder.

4. Copy EVERYTHING from the zip's "Win64" folder into that Win64 folder
   (dwmapi.dll and the ue4ss folder). When you're done, the folder contains:
       EXGameSteam-Win64-Shipping.exe
       dwmapi.dll
       ue4ss\...

5. Start the game from Steam as usual.
   - A small "GUNS & DRAGONS TRAINER" window opens next to the game after a few seconds.
   - Its top line says "Connected to game" once the trainer is running.
   - All cheats start switched OFF. Turn on what you want in the window. Settings are saved
     automatically and remembered next time.


THE TRAINER WINDOW
------------------
- Insert: shows or hides the window. You can change this key in the window.
- Drag the title bar to move it. The position is remembered.
- The top line shows whether you are Solo, Hosting, or Joined (client), and what aim assist is
  locked onto.


WHAT WORKS WHERE (ONLINE CO-OP)
-------------------------------
The trainer only ever changes YOUR character. Teammates are never affected.

Work when you HOST or play SOLO (the host's game decides these):
  - Infinite health, infinite ammo, infinite armor
  - Loot magnet (pulls pickups to you)

Work whether you host or JOIN someone else:
  - Aim assist and everything in the Aim assist section
  - Highlights (supplies and pickups, loot chests, secret walls) and minimap icons
  - Ping key

Fully work when you host. When you join, they work partly or not at all, because the host's game has
the final say:
  - No spread, fire rate multiplier (also bow draw speed), reload speed, movement speed,
    no dash cooldown. Joined players may get pulled back (rubber-banding) with movement speed.


FEATURES
--------
Cheats (host/solo)
  Infinite health / ammo / armor, loot magnet (with radius).

Weapon & movement
  No spread, fire rate multiplier, reload speed multiplier, movement speed multiplier,
  no dash cooldown.

Aim assist (default: hold Right Mouse)
  - Locks onto the enemy closest to your crosshair within the radius and distance you set.
  - Aims at the weak spot, then the head, then the upper body. Works on wall-mounted enemies.
  - Skips friendly summons (e.g. Thorn Blooms).
  - Shoots lifeline imps and soul-binding shamans first, because they make other enemies
    invulnerable.
  - Prefers explosive gear (barrels, grenades) when it faces you.
  - Aims over held shields.
  - Ignores mushrooms while they are ducked (they block damage then).
  - Leads moving targets and compensates for bullet drop.
  - "Aim assist targets supplies": also shoots the flying clay supplies, one shot each, then the next
    clay.
  Mode, hold key, radius, snap strength and max distance are set in the window.

Supplies & highlights
  - Highlight supplies and pickups: clay launchers (bone/tomb/barrel piles), flying clays, pickups.
  - Highlight loot chests: resource chests, artifact boxes, secret room chests.
  - Highlight secret walls: cracked breakable walls.
  - Show highlights on minimap (experimental): draws icons for highlighted chests, launchers and
    secret walls on the minimap, including ones the game itself hides.

Ping key (default F8)
  Logs whatever is under your crosshair to ue4ss\Mods\GunsDragonsTrainer\pings.txt. It changes nothing
  in the game. Useful for reporting enemies or objects the trainer should handle.


RELOADING WITHOUT RESTARTING THE GAME
-------------------------------------
- Ctrl+R in game reloads all UE4SS mods, including the trainer.
- Replacing the trainer's script files while the game runs reloads it automatically.


UNINSTALL
---------
Delete dwmapi.dll and the ue4ss folder from ...\EX\Binaries\Win64.


TROUBLESHOOTING
---------------
The game crashes right at launch
  - Make sure ue4ss\MemberVariableLayout.ini was copied. UE4SS crashes on this game without it.
  - If the game was updated after this trainer was made, the engine layout may have changed, and the
    trainer needs updating. To play without it until then, rename dwmapi.dll to dwmapi.dll.disabled.

No trainer window appears
  - Wait about 10 seconds after the game window opens.
  - Run the game in Borderless or Windowed mode.
  - Press Insert in case the window is hidden.
  - You can also start it by hand: ue4ss\Mods\GunsDragonsTrainer\TrainerGUI.exe

Window says "Game running, mod not responding"
  Open ue4ss\UE4SS.log and look for lines containing "[G&D Trainer]". The last error is also shown
  at the bottom of the trainer window.

Antivirus warning about dwmapi.dll
  dwmapi.dll is UE4SS's loader. It works by loading itself into the game, which some antivirus
  programs flag. You may need to allow it.

Health/ammo/armor do nothing
  You joined someone else's game. These only work when you host or play solo (see above).

Files the trainer writes (safe to delete; they are recreated)
  ue4ss\Mods\GunsDragonsTrainer\settings.ini       your settings
  ...\status.ini, probe.txt, enemies.txt, pings.txt, runtime_state.txt   status and diagnostics
  ue4ss\UE4SS.log                                   UE4SS log
  ue4ss\crash_*.dmp                                 crash dumps, if the game ever crashed
